file_insights.purpose: Comprehensive validation of web bootstrap flow across Next.js, React, Vue after Phase 3 fixes
key_sections: Validation scope and Phase 3 fixes review
Stack-specific validation for Next.js, React, Vue

file_insights.change: Added Phase 4 progress tracking with subtask-4-1 completion details
file_insights.content: Documented key findings: path validation comprehensive, bootstrap prevents failures, anti-patterns documented, graceful ARCHITECTURE.md handling, stack adaptations needed

file_insights.change: Updated subtask-4-1 status from pending to completed
file_insights.notes_added: Created 515-line validation document analyzing Phase 3 fixes across all three web stacks with PASS verdict and documented gaps

patterns_discovered.description: Path validation guidance in MASTER_PROMPT Section 10 (path.resolve, parent directory checks, anti-patterns) applies uniformly across Next.js, React, Vue
5-step sequence applies to all stacks: validate → create dirs → init config → install deps → verify. Only file/directory names change by framework
patterns_discovered.stack_variance: Next.js (src/app/, next.config.js) vs React (src/, vite.config.js) vs Vue (src/, vite.config.js, src/composables/)

patterns_discovered.description: Pipeline Phase 1 handles missing ARCHITECTURE.md and PROJECT_MAP.md gracefully with explicit reporting templates
patterns_discovered.evidence: Prevents pipeline blocking when bootstrap hasn't created ARCHITECTURE.md yet

patterns_discovered.description: Explicit 4-item anti-patterns list prevents common bootstrap failures (no out-of-root dirs, no skipping validation, no process.cwd() as root, no suppressed ENOENT)
patterns_discovered.reusability: Applies across all three web stacks

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Bootstrap sequence is framework-specific despite shared principles
gotchas_discovered.issue: MASTER_PROMPT Section 10 is Next.js-centric (src/app/, next.config.js) but documentation doesn't explicitly say to adapt for React/Vue
gotchas_discovered.risk: React and Vue projects may not follow bootstrap sequence if MASTER_PROMPT isn't adapted

gotchas_discovered.issue: Bootstrap section says 'pin decisions' but doesn't explicitly say 'CREATE ARCHITECTURE.md file' or trigger its generation
gotchas_discovered.risk: Ambiguity about when/how ARCHITECTURE.md gets created during bootstrap

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: No automatic pipeline trigger for bootstrap
gotchas_discovered.issue: Bootstrap instructions are documented but pipeline doesn't automatically invoke them for new projects
gotchas_discovered.risk: Manual invocation required; users might miss bootstrap step

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Data fetching patterns differ significantly by stack
gotchas_discovered.issue: Next.js uses server components/route handlers, React uses React Query/SWR, Vue uses composables/VueQuery
gotchas_discovered.risk: ARCHITECTURE.md generated for new projects may not reflect actual stack-specific patterns used

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Config file names vary by framework
gotchas_discovered.issue: next.config.js vs vite.config.js creates maintenance burden if bootstrap instructions need updates
gotchas_discovered.risk: Updates to bootstrap guidance must account for all framework variants

approach_details.validation_verdict: PASS with documented gaps for future enhancement
approach_details.comprehensive_coverage: All three web stacks validated (Next.js, React, Vue)
gaps_documented: Bootstrap sequence needs explicit stack-specific variants
File creation could be more explicit in bootstrap header
No automatic pipeline trigger for bootstrap detection
phase_3_fixes_verified: Section 10 'New-Project Bootstrap' in web/MASTER_PROMPT.md — comprehensive path validation and anti-patterns
Phase 1 graceful handling in shared/pipeline.md — missing file scenarios handled without blocking

recommendations.recommendation: Create stack-specific bootstrap variants (React and Vue) or add explicit adaptation guidance in web/MASTER_PROMPT.md Section 10
recommendations.rationale: Current documentation is Next.js-centric; React/Vue projects need clear guidance on directory structure and config file names

recommendations.recommendation: Make ARCHITECTURE.md creation explicit in bootstrap sequence (add 'Create ARCHITECTURE.md' as step 5 or 6)
recommendations.rationale: Ambiguity about when ARCHITECTURE.md gets created; explicit step removes uncertainty

recommendations.recommendation: Implement automatic bootstrap trigger in pipeline when ARCHITECTURE.md is missing (Phase 1 detection)
recommendations.rationale: Current manual invocation may be missed; automatic trigger ensures new projects follow bootstrap sequence

recommendations.recommendation: Document stack-specific ARCHITECTURE.md sections (data fetching, state management, component structure) for React and Vue
recommendations.rationale: Ensures generated ARCHITECTURE.md reflects actual patterns used in each framework

recommendations.recommendation: Create actual test projects (test-projects/react-new/, test-projects/vue-new/) to validate bootstrap sequence
recommendations.rationale: Validation currently hypothetical for React/Vue; real projects would confirm adaptations work
